title: Mid-game unstuck: with 5-8 alive, when we have barely moved for ~5 s and are not in a drop ring, settling by P29, healing or fighting, pick a nearby reachable spot and move (UNSTUCK_MID_ON)
behaviors: With 5-8 alive and mid phase, if our own position moved < a few m over ~5 s, we are not in/holding a drop ring, not inside P29's settle, not healing and not engaged, re-path to a reachable in-zone point a short distance away. Drop run, midring settle and zone rules unchanged. Own observations only.
source: Watcher refresh 74cdbcf (9:29-9:33 PM ET, 128 showdown matches)

evidence.watcher: 5-8 alive: top teams stuck 12.0% vs 30.8% of ticks (d=-0.47; 97/95 matches), speed 8.06 vs 5.05 m/s; mid phase stuck 10.3% vs 30.2%. 2-4 alive: 9.6% vs 21.0%. Correlation only, exhibition FFA, not the house squad.

non_overlap: Not P28 midring patrol (retired), not P40b roof jet route, not P45 (spot choice inside the settle). Movement P-B-008 strafe/modes stayed sim-only and on hold; this is a stuck trigger, not strafing.
step_a: Log-only on P48 champion b9492c6 (TREE_RETREAT_ON=true), trees-on, bases 2000-5000 (96 each): count games with a 5 s stuck stretch (moved < few m) with 5-8 alive, mid phase, outside drop rings/drop run/near-reachable drop (DROP_RUN_M gate)/P29 settle/heal/fight, where the unstuck would fire and change behavior; plus deaths or zone damage within 20 s after. Pass: >= 10/192 games on both sets (2000+3000 and 4000+5000).
